conservative.read: This conservative plan targets around 1.5% per month, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and lowering concentration. Expect lower volatility and drawdowns, but also more modest returns.

balanced.read: This balanced plan aims for approximately 2.5% per month, prioritizing risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and diversifies slightly with a quality new add. Expect moderate volatility and drawdowns, with a focus on sustainable growth.
